name: R5 Phase 2 round 2 (v5), requested by the user after round 1; written before any round-2 dev2 result exists
context: round 1 (r5/prereg_phase2.json) selected v4 + m=1 entrance; the dev1 sensitivity analysis (an analysis, not a decision input in round 1) showed larger dev1 gains for some settings. dev2 has not been evaluated for any of the round-2 settings below except m=1 alone.
baseline: v4 (n0=12, |K|=5, m=2 with entrance 0.40/0.30/0.10, LP kg=10, lambda(alpha)=0.9, gamma=3, 15 warm sweeps)

m: 1 (entrance 0.30/0.20/0.10191613, frozen from the dev1 tuning in (2))

search: coordinate-wise on dev1 in the order above, starting from v4; for each factor every level is evaluated with the other factors at their current values; the level with the lowest mean dev1 near FPR95 among levels whose mean dev1 far FPR95 difference to v4 is <= +0.5 is kept (ties keep the current value)
conditions: the 15 matched conditions per dev split (5 shot draws x 3 order seeds); score S_final x prod_views p_t x prod_views p_LP; draw-level means, 95% t interval over draws
selection_dev1: the final configuration must beat v4 on dev1 (upper end of the 95% CI of the near FPR95 difference < 0)
confirmation_dev2: upper end of the 95% CI of the near FPR95 difference to v4 on dev2 < 0 and mean far FPR95 difference <= +0.5
adoption: if confirmed, v5 = the round-2 configuration; otherwise v5 = the round-1 decision (v4 + m=1 entrance). Nothing else is changed; test data are not used.
